name: Meteoric-Rift
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs solar wind erosion patterns, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Approach protocols for the pirate hideout are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
